author: KitchenKween88
title: Grocery list now Premium??
review: Used this app for two years and now the grocery list is behind Premium. That was the whole reason I used it.

author: tilly.bakes
title: Aisle sorting!
review: The grocery list sorting itself by supermarket aisle is genius. Shopping takes half the time.

author: lowtide_lou
title: Need a calendar view
review: Need a calendar view. Half the week it's just me and the other half my kids are here, so the plan makes way too much food on my nights alone.

author: dana.cooks
title: Bait and switch
review: The free grocery list was why I picked this over other planners. Paying 6.99 a month just for a shopping list is too much.

author: Ben Ashdown
title: Great recipes
review: Recipes are actually tested and work. Weeknight dinners sorted.

author: KitchenKween88
title: Still paywalled
review: Updated hoping they listened. Nope. Grocery list still locked. Ads between every recipe step too.

author: Ivo Szabo
title: Too many notifications
review: Three notifications a day reminding me to plan meals is too much.

author: Marguerite T
title: Too many ads
review: An ad pops up between each step of the recipe while my hands are covered in flour.

author: noodlequeen
title: Love it
review: Best meal planner I've tried. The aisle-sorted list is my favourite thing.

author: Priya_in_Leeds
title: Calendar please
review: Please add a calendar. My partner works away Monday to Wednesday and I end up throwing out half of what I bought.

author: busydadof3
title: Grocery list paywall
review: Can't justify the subscription. Back to writing my list on paper.

author: C. Varga
title: Worth it
review: Premium is worth every penny for our family of five.

author: R. Bellweather
title: Import broken
review: Pasting a recipe link from a blog just shows 'Could not read recipe'. Worked fine before the update.

author: KitchenKween88
title: Worse every update
review: Now there's a video ad before I can open my own meal plan. Grocery list still Premium. Uninstalling soon.

author: June Okafor-Lind
title: Lost everything
review: After the update it asked me to sign in with Apple. I did and all 200 of my saved recipes and three years of meal plans are gone. Support hasn't replied.

author: grahamcracker
title: Saved recipes deleted
review: Signed in with Apple as the app asked after updating and my account came up empty. Every saved recipe gone.

author: cooking_with_kez
title: Can't import recipes anymore
review: Recipe import from URL fails every time on my Pixel.

author: hollyhock22
title: Almost perfect
review: Would be 5 stars with a calendar view.

author: Hal Brennan
title: Solid
review: Good recipes, easy plan builder.

author: Alder Finch
title: Import error
review: Every website I try gives 'Could not read recipe'. My wife's iPhone imports the same link fine.

author: Ollie R.
title: Shopping list locked
review: Grocery list moved to Premium with no warning. Not cool.

author: Lena K
title: Dark mode
review: Please add dark mode.

author: Teo M.
title: Weekly calendar
review: I want a proper calendar. Some nights we're 2, some nights 5 when the grandkids stay, and every recipe assumes 4.

author: nonnaG
title: Import still broken
review: Still can't import from links after the latest update. I have 30 recipes I can't add.

author: rosemary_and_tim
title: So easy
review: Planning the week takes ten minutes now.

author: KitchenKween88
title: Do not download
review: Ads, paywall, ads. Grocery list locked. One star until they fix it.

author: pat_the_cook
title: Slow
review: Takes a long time to load the plan screen.

author: fernandvine
title: Price
review: Nice app, but the price for Premium is way more than I'd pay for a meal planner.

author: mika.eats
title: URL import
review: Import from URL just spins and fails. Android 15.

author: Wren P.
title: Fantastic
review: Love the leftovers suggestions and the aisle sorting.

author: sam_and_the_sprouts
title: Calendar view
review: Love the recipes. A calendar view would be great.
